subject: Request: Non-standard terms for Civica Health onboarding + custom integration
messages:
From: Emma Lowe <emma@civica.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Civica Health Procurement <procurement@civica.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: bundled premium support + integration scope for RFP

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the product looks promising. Procurement asked me to follow up with the ask below so we can finalize the RFP response and get to signature before the end of the month. The key asks from our side:

- One-time commercial concession: 25% discount on year 1 list for the base seats
- Include Premium Support (24/7) at no charge for the first 90 days
- Custom integration: FHIR connector + SSO + nightly ETL (rough scope included in the attached SOW)

We have constrained budget in Q4 and those items are what will get us over the finish line. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate these items? If there are alternative structures (e.g., smaller discount + integration credit) we’re open to options.

Attached: Civica_SOW_draft.pdf, Usage_forecast.xlsx

We need an answer by COB Nov 24 to keep procurement timelines. Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Emma Lowe
VP, Digital Programs | Civica Health
ema: emma@civica.ai
phone: +1-415-555-0198


From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@civica.ai>
Cc: Civica Health Procurement <procurement@civica.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: bundled premium support + integration scope for RFP

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the SOW. We’re interested in moving quickly here. A few immediate notes and requests so we can route this internally: 

- Any discount >15% and complimentary managed services require Deal Desk + Exec approval.
- The integration items you listed (FHIR connector, SSO, nightly ETL) are doable but the current SOW is broad — we’ll need to scope & cap effort.
- Can you confirm expected monthly token/embedding volume in the attached forecast? The cost/ops impact is sensitive to usage.

I’ve attached integration_spec_v2.docx with a few questions inline about connectors and SLAs. I’ll escalate to Marissa/Ben for an approval decision and come back with a proposal (concession options + conditional terms).

Two quick asks for you: 1) if procurement requires 90-day complimentary support, would Civica accept a time-limited credit (e.g., equal to the support SRV fee) if we can’t fully waive the cost? 2) confirm target signature date.

I’ll loop back before COB Nov 24.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: ESCALATION: Civica Health — request for 25% discount + 90d premium support + custom integration (Deal CIV-2026-089)

Team — escalating Civica request for executive signoff. Key points: 

- Customer: Civica Health (mid-market payer). Deal ID: CIV-2026-089. Region: US.
- Ask: 25% off Y1 list + complimentary Premium Support for first 90 days + custom integration (FHIR, SSO, nightly ETL).
- Rationale: procurement has a strict Q4 target; losing 2–3 weeks here will push them to a competitor.

Commercial impact (quick estimate):
- Estimated ARR (year-1 net): $420k (after proposed 25% concession)
- Expected COGS (support + infra ops + implementation) increase: ~$58k in year-1
- Incremental implementation effort (engineering + services): 6–10 weeks; we’d need to prioritize onboarding calendar.

Concession options I recommend we consider (ranked):
A) Approve 20% discount + complimentary Premium Support for 90 days + customer pays integration implementation ($45k cap) — fastest way to close.
B) Approve 12% discount + $40k integration credit + complimentary Premium Support for 60 days.
C) Decline complimentary support; offer 20% discount + 60-day support credit + customer-paid integration (adjust MSA payment timing).

Attachments: Civica_SOW_draft.pdf, Usage_forecast.xlsx, integration_spec_v2.docx

Request: Marissa/Ben — need an exec direction (approve option A/B/C or alternate) so I can get back to the customer before COB Nov 24.

Thanks,
Jasmine
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: Civica Health — request for 25% discount + 90d premium support + custom integration (Deal CIV-2026-089)

Jasmine — thanks for the concise rundown. My read: Civica is strategic from a vertical reference perspective but the 25% + 90d free support + open integration cap is too aggressive without clearer scope controls. 

I prefer Option B with tightened acceptance criteria on integration. Specifically: 
- 12% discount only (protects margin + keeps us competitive)
- $40k integration credit, customer signs SOW to a clearly itemized scope; any out-of-scope work billed T&M at $250/hr
- Premium Support included for 60 days (not 90) and limited to P1/P2 SLA coverage
- Require standard MSA and net-30 payment; no extended credit without finance sign-off

Ben — are you comfortable with 12% + $40k credit + 60d support? If we need to be more aggressive I want to understand expected total ARR and reference value to justify.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: Civica Health — request for 25% discount + 90d premium support + custom integration (Deal CIV-2026-089)

Marissa/Jasmine — thanks for the analysis. Given Civica’s vertical and the speed requirement from procurement, I’ll approve a narrow exception but we must protect delivery and cash. Executive decision:

- Approve a one-time 20% discount cap on year-1 list (no stacking beyond 20%).
- Customer to pay a $30k one-time integration fee (this replaces the $40k/$45k credit options) — if actual integration cost exceeds $30k, we will bill overage T&M at $250/hr after written change order.
- Include Premium Support at no cost for the first 60 days only (P1/P2 SLAs).
- Condition: signed MSA and initial invoice paid within 30 days of signature (net-30).
- Sales commission will be adjusted accordingly (finance ops — please reflect).

Jasmine — please send Civica a revised SOW that reflects the approved terms and closes the scope (attach change order language). Ask Emma if they can accept the $30k integration fee and 60-day support. If they push back and insist on 90 days or a larger discount, escalate back to me with explicit ROI argument.

I’ll log the decision in the deal record (CIV-2026-089) and notify Finance & Legal to prepare updated documents.

—Ben
Ben Carter
SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference
